mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SM.PERMS FROM sys_menu SM LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm on SM.ID = srm.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON SUR.ROLE_ID = SRM.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_role sr on sr.ID = SUR.ROLE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SM.STATUS = '1' AND SR.STATUS = '1' AND SUR.USER_ID = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT M.ID, M.PARENT_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PATH, M.COMPONENT, M.QUERY_PARAM, M.VISIBLE, M.STATUS, M.PERMS, M.IS_FRAME, M.IS_CACHE, M.MENU_TYPE, M.ICON, M.ORDER_NUM, M.CREATE_TIME FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu RM on M.ID = RM.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR on RM.ROLE_ID = SUR.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_role R on R.ID = SUR.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user U ON U.ID = SUR.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.ID = #{userId} AND M.MENU_TYPE IN ('D', 'M') AND M.STATUS = '1' AND R.STATUS = '1' ORDER BY M.PARENT_ID, M.ORDER_NUM

SELECT DISTINCT M.ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PARENT_ID, M.ORDER_NUM, M.VISIBLE, M.ICON FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm on M.ID = srm.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON SUR.ROLE_ID = SRM.ROLE_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
SELECT RM.MENU_ID FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu RM ON M.ID = RM.MENU_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.LOGIC_DEL = '0' AND M.STATUS = '1' AND M.MENU_TYPE IN ('D', 'M', 'B') AND RM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
SELECT M.ID FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu RM ON M.ID = RM.MENU_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.LOGIC_DEL = '0' AND M.STATUS = '1' AND M.MENU_TYPE IN ('D', 'M', 'B')

SELECT DISTINCT M.ID, M.REC_VER, M.LOGIC_DEL, M.PARENT_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_TYPE, M.ORDER_NUM, M.ICON, M.PATH, M.COMPONENT, M.PERMS, M.VISIBLE, M.STATUS, M.IS_FRAME, M.IS_CACHE, M.REMARK FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu RM ON M.ID = RM.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON RM.ROLE_ID = SUR.ROLE_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT DISTINCT M.ID, M.PARENT_ID, M.MENU_NAME AS TITLE, M.ID AS FIELD FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu RM ON M.ID = RM.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON RM.ROLE_ID = SUR.ROLE_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_MENU WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMPONENT = #{component} AND COMPONENT NOT IN ('modal', 'blank') )

SELECT DISTINCT M.ID, M.REC_VER, M.BUILD_IN, M.MENU_NAME, M.PARENT_ID, M.ORDER_NUM, M.PATH, M.COMPONENT, M.IS_CACHE, M.MENU_TYPE, M.VISIBLE, M.STATUS, M.PERMS, M.ICON, M.REMARK FROM sys_menu M ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM sys_menu M LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm on M.ID = srm.MENU_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
